notes.text: a cone with a ball as the head and 2 other cones as the arms.... NO ! i want something else
notes.reply: Done (2026-11-27): no more cones — a tall wraith of ice: the v2 body in translucent pale ice under a hood, a ragged robe trailing into tatters where its legs would be, ice shards on its shoulders, long icy claws reaching out, cold eyes in the hood. It still drifts and shows itself only up close.
